params.move: 0..1 the owner key arcs from post a (left) to post b (right); the holder's lamp is green
params.bad: 0..1 post a's lamp turns red (a used after the move: the compiler's error)
params.read: 0..3 reader lenses light one by one (shared borrows)
params.write: 0..1 the writer stamp lowers onto the crate and turns green; the lenses go dark (exclusive borrow)
params.free: 0..1 the hatch opens and the crate sinks through the pad and fades; the key and lamps go too (freed)
